bindings.why: Only inside a running exact-build selected-stack receipt, invokes the real public record export CLI on the private fixture's world. Independently reads the populated native catalogue through capxul_core, compares lineage and every ordered epoch/sequence row with the private JSONL file, and checks exact public line/byte counts and owner-only permissions. Missing schema, absent rows, wrong world/build or unavailable live stack fail. Does not claim clone acceptance, grants, spans, budgets or complete command capture.

Within a running selected-stack receipt, verifies the private fixture and public live world inspection, then reads this world's actual app.worlds schema through capxul_core. Compares every field's SQL type and nullability, primary-key order, named index fields/uniqueness and validated enums with independent blueprint expectations. Missing runtime/schema evidence fails.

Uses the same selected world, receipt and live inspection, not a component proof. Reads the physical app.world_snapshots catalogue and compares all fields/types/nullability, compound key, named created-at index and clock enum; retains the actual schema observation in this run.

Reads the selected world's actual app.command_records through the restricted tenant role after the live-stack guard. Independently checks all searchable fields/types/nullability, world/epoch/sequence key, named actor/trace indexes and kind/actor/outcome/surface enums. Does not substitute Core's narrower app.records or claim command capture, writer exclusivity, lifecycle, telemetry, budgets or composed recovery.
